💬 "Kimi has shown several times this season that he is able to put setbacks behind him quickly. The pace has been there throughout the weekend, and the objective tomorrow will be to recover as many positions as possible."
Hear from George, Kimi, Bradley and Shov after Qualifying in Friday's report 👇

💬 “Kimi本赛季已多次证明，他能够迅速把挫折抛在身后。整个周末速度一直都在，明天的目标是尽可能追回更多位置。”
